name: eve-host
title: Eve Host

origin.source: Eve (Vercel's agent framework) folder convention (agent.ts + tools/<snake_case>.ts) calling runAgent; typechecks standalone via local eve-shims mirroring eve.dev/docs as of 2026-07 (Eve is not a repo dependency)

comparison.purpose: The Eve LLM agent gets two tools bridging to the shared email-draft machine: start_workflow runs runAgent to the first human pause and returns a handle, the draft, and the machine's typed interaction; resume_workflow reloads the snapshot and delivers the human's choice, deriving the payload field from meta.interaction. The machine owns legality; the agent converses.

starters: Draft an email telling the team the deploy pipeline is twice as fast.
Ask for changes to the draft, then send it.
